scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics, acquisition, and bounded version/context evidence reviewed in Batch 426.
findings: 100-Ki Power Up Super from PQ49 Basic Reward. Current skill documentation describes an activation that knocks back nearby enemies, deals about 1% damage, and grants a 10% received-damage reduction for 20 seconds. Community evidence also describes the activation's short animation and knockback utility, but those observations are not promoted into exact frame data.
unresolved: Exact current activation/invulnerability/recovery frames remain unresolved.
The 20-second/10% values are retained as current source-reported values, not independently measured frame data.
Patch-independent scaling and interactions with other buffs remain unresolved.
